themes.name: Aizome Shoten
themes.description: A typographic, retro theme for independent bookshops and small presses that sell books, zines and stationery, set like a mid-century Japanese pocket paperback: condensed capitals on a kinari page, indigo spine labels down every page head, catalogue numbers in mono, a strict twelve-column editorial grid with double rules, a persimmon obi band and book covers that lift off the table, plus readings and events with a chair reservation form, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match, in aizome indigo, kinari paper, sumi ink and pale asagi blue with one persimmon accent.

themes.name: Akachōchin
themes.description: Akachōchin — An izakaya theme laid out as a card mosaic in shu vermilion (#EB6101), the main colour on the full hero field, the page heads, the menu overlay and the mosaic cards, with sumi brown-black, warm paper and deep vermilion links; Reggae One display over Sawarabi Gothic. The pictures are documentary-style photographs (35 mm, available light, handheld, fine grain, graded toward vermilion): the hero is a pair of tall vertical banners, a sumi nobori with the shop name set vertically beside a tall photograph of the lantern alley, with a red paper lantern as a transparent cut-out hanging over both; a cut-out sake flask breaks out of its vermilion card in the mosaic. A full top header: the shop name, a Reserve a seat button and a menu button that opens a full-screen vermilion overlay. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. Tonight's board and the shop details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-19 (card-mosaic archetype, vertical-banner hero, overlay nav, real-photography images, documentary photo direction, shu #EB6101, Reggae One + Sawarabi Gothic). Contrast: sumi brown-black #1E1009 on shu vermilion #EB6101 5.5:1 (all text on the hero field, page heads, the menu overlay and the vermilion cards); white on sumi 18.5:1; shu on sumi 5.5:1 (header tag line, nobori caption, footer name, header button); sumi on warm paper #FBF1E7 16.6:1; deep vermilion #A63E00 on paper 5.7:1 and on white 6.3:1; quiet #5C4234 on paper 8.2:1 and on white 9.2:1; white on shu only 3.4:1, never used for text.

themes.name: Amane Wagashi
themes.description: An elegant, quiet store theme for a small Kyoto-style wagashi (Japanese confectionery) house that makes a different sweet each month, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Blush washi paper, pale azuki panels, deep azuki-brown ink and a muted azuki red; Kaisei Tokumin for display, Plus Jakarta Sans for text. A magazine masthead (H5) with a quiet dateline that shows the season of the site's own calendar (Late autumn · Month of the chestnut, from the WordPress timezone through a block binding), the house name in large type beside a small round azuki seal and a ruled menu row. The home page is built around a sideways-scrolling seasonal tray (L4): twelve months of sweets, January camellia to December yuzu, each a framed card with photograph, month, name, note and price, scroll-snap, keyboard and touch scrollable, plain-anchor earlier/later and month links, this month marked In season now. Seasonal calendar (all twelve months as a grid) and Pre-orders pages (choose a box, pick a day, collect or delivery; editable Most chosen badge), plus shop, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The footer (F6) is a street sketch with one pin beside a quiet visit and pre-order card. The shop address, hours, telephone, email and pre-order cut-off are one synced pattern (masthead dateline, footer card, Pre-orders, Contact); the twelve sweets with prices are one synced pattern (home tray, Shop, Seasonal calendar). WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows the tray and orders go by telephone or email.
themes.deviation: Footer switched from the planned F7 to F6 (map + address card), decided by the orchestrator: Yohaku Studio already uses H5+F7; H5+F6+L4 is unused, and neighbours #10 Koke Garden (H4/F9/L8) and #12 Suzuri Shodo (H12/F11/L5) stay adjacent-safe. F6 differs from Sumai Realty, Tabi Note and Tsumiki Accounting by a quiet street sketch (inline SVG: river, the old stone bridge, two streets, one azuki pin) on a pale azuki panel beside a rice-paper visit and pre-order card fed by the synced shop details, then a ruled centred menu row; no CTA band. H5 differs from Oto Radio, Sushi Ginza and Yohaku Studio by a dateline whose season words come from the site's WordPress timezone (block binding amane-wagashi/season, never the visitor clock), a centred Kaisei Tokumin house name beside a CSS azuki seal and a double-ruled menu row; at 390 px the name stays on one line and the menu becomes Menu + cart. L4 differs from Kinu Kimono (rack on a gold rail) and Kiroku Studio (case reel) by framed rice-paper cards standing on a pale azuki tray board with a wooden edge, a twelve-month anchor index and the current month marked server-side. Palette as planned plus rice #FBF8F6 cards, hairline #CDB5AE, quiet brown #6A5450 and deep azuki #6E3F3B for small text and links. AA: ink #3A2826 12.2:1 on washi, 9.5:1 on pale azuki; muted azuki #8E5A55 4.9:1 on washi (AA) but 3.8:1 on pale azuki, so it is kept to large type, marks, prices on rice and the seal; deep azuki #6E3F3B 7.6:1 on washi, 5.9:1 on pale azuki; quiet #6A5450 6.2:1 on washi, 4.8:1 on pale azuki. Kaisei Tokumin and Plus Jakarta Sans verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/kaiseitokumin, ofl/plusjakartasans OFL.txt); Kaisei Tokumin Regular + Medium subset to Latin (the CJK font is ~4.5 MB each, ~20 KB as Latin WOFF2), Plus Jakarta Sans limited to wght 300-600 and subset (~62 KB fonts in total). Industry wagashi and page tags seasonal-calendar and pre-orders are new. The confectioner portrait reuses a crop when its photograph is missing. Newsletter page added because check-themes requires it.

themes.name: Amime Takezaiku
themes.description: Amime Takezaiku — a WooCommerce store theme for a bamboo basket workshop in a mountain valley, laid out as horizontal strips you read from left to right. A formal white top header carries the shop name, the Shop the baskets button, account and cart; from 1100 px the main menu stands as a fixed sumi side rail on the left (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese), below that it opens from a Menu button as a full-screen kariyasu overlay. Kariyasu yellow (#F5E56B) is the main colour: the hero field, the shelf band, the grove card, every page head and the footer strip are kariyasu fields with sumi olive-black text, and woven bamboo textures (ajiro twill and kagome hexagon, raster watercolour) run through them. The hero sets the shop line on the left and a framed watercolour of the bamboo grove on the right; a cut-out round basket (transparent WebP) breaks out over the frame and the hero's bottom edge. The workshop board is one horizontal strip, the five steps from grove to basket stand side by side on one long bamboo strip, the baskets line up on a shelf that scrolls sideways, and a full-bleed grove panorama carries a kariyasu card that a cut-out flower basket breaks out of. Every picture is a soft watercolour illustration. Sawarabi Mincho for display, Urbanist for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-13 (horizontal-strip, text-left-art-right hero, side-rail nav, pattern-texture, watercolour, kariyasu #F5E56B, Sawarabi Mincho + Urbanist, bamboo basketry in crafts-homeware). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left; the Shop the baskets button, account and cart on the right. Side rail: from 1100 px the main menu stands as a fixed sumi rail down the left edge below the header, numbered entries (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese) with a woven kariyasu edge; below 1100 px it opens from a Menu button as a full-screen kariyasu overlay. Horizontal strip: the home page reads as horizontal bands; the workshop board is one strip of five cells, the five steps from grove to basket stand side by side on one long bamboo strip, the baskets line up on a shelf that scrolls sideways, the grove is one wide panorama strip and the notes are one row each. Text left, art right: the shop line, lead and buttons on the left of the kariyasu hero, a framed watercolour of the bamboo grove on the right. Pattern texture: raster watercolour ajiro twill and kagome hexagon weaves run through the hero, the side rail edge, the step strip, the shelf band, page heads and the footer strip. Watercolour: every picture is a soft watercolour illustration (Grok Build). Break-frame: the cut-out round basket (transparent WebP) breaks out over the hero frame and over the hero bottom edge into the board; the cut-out flower basket breaks out of the kariyasu card over the top edge of the grove band; the basket also breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: sumi olive-black #22200F on kariyasu #F5E56B 12.7:1 (all text on the hero field, the shelf band, page heads, the board lead cell, the band card and the footer strip; the woven textures multiplied in only darken the field slightly); ink on kariyasu washi #FFFCEB 15.9:1, on white 16.4:1 and on pale kariyasu #FAF3C4 14.6:1; deep olive #5F5410 on washi 7.4:1, on white 7.6:1 and on kariyasu 5.9:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.6:1); quiet olive grey #5A5644 on washi 7.2:1 (secondary text); pale kariyasu #F9EFA0 on ink 14.0:1 and kariyasu on ink 12.7:1 (side rail numbers, buttons, chips, footer); bamboo green #4F6B2E on washi 5.9:1 (small dots only); white on kariyasu only 1.3:1, never used for text.

themes.name: Aoi Hanga
themes.description: Aoi Hanga — a store theme for a small woodblock print studio, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Moegi spring green (#A9C08B) is the main colour on the top-bar header, the hero band, the editions grid and every page head, set against sumi green-black ink; Mochiy Pop One for display and Kosugi Maru for reading. The hero puts the studio line on the left and the art on the right: a sumi-ink cut-out of a carved cherry block with a baren and knives tilts out of its frame and hangs past the bottom of the band. The home page is one long single column (numbered chapters on the block, the ink and the press) broken by full-width sumi-ink plates, then this season’s editions, the journal and the print letter. The studio details and the edition terms each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the editions show as static cells and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-14 (single-column-longform, text-left-art-right hero, top-bar nav, full-illustration images, sumi-ink illustration, moegi #A9C08B, Mochiy Pop One + Kosugi Maru). Every picture is a sumi-ink raster illustration; the hero block is also a transparent cut-out that breaks out of its frame and the band. Contrast: sumi ink #1F2A1A on moegi #A9C08B 7.6:1 (all text on the moegi header, hero, editions band and page heads); ink on pale moegi page #F1F5EA 13.5:1; pine links #3E5A2A on #F1F5EA 7.0:1; moss #4A5640 on #F1F5EA 7.0:1; moegi on sumi footer 7.6:1; pale #EEF3E6 on sumi 13.9:1; deep moegi #5F7A45 on #F1F5EA 4.4:1 (large drop caps and marks only).

themes.name: Aozora Primary School
themes.description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a small independent primary school: morning-white ground, chalk-stone bands and ink text with a single fujinezu (wisteria grey #6E75A4) accent, Alegreya over Alegreya Sans. The home page opens with a morning classroom photograph inset with large rounded corners and a notched corner over a pale band, the headline set as three stacked caption lines overlapping its edge, a dashed open-morning note and three equal gateways (visit, apply, families); then a welcome from the head, a school day as a horizontal strip of photographs, teachers by name, what children learn on a band with a slanted soft-wave edge, admissions steps with the fees and open days as plain lists, the journal and a visit invitation with overlapping photographs, a pill bar and a ring-text badge. With A school day, Curriculum, Teachers, Admissions, Fees and open days, About, Contact, Parents' letter and Journal. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.

themes.name: Asa Linen
themes.description: A serene, organic store theme for a small linen bedding atelier, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Flax washi pages with a faint linen weave drawn in CSS, stone panels, warm ink text and one faded sage accent; Crimson Pro for display, Nunito Sans for text. A transparent header lies over the opening photograph of a made bed and turns solid washi as the page scrolls (H8); the home page then follows four chapters (flax, weave, wash, sleep) scrolling beside a sticky photograph of the made bed (L13), then the three families of bedding, a care and delivery note and the journal. A Fabric guide (linen weights, weave and finish, a size table) and a Care page (four habits, what to avoid, delivery and returns); atelier, journal, newsletter and contact pages. A photo-strip footer of five softly faded photographs over a stone colophon with the visit rows of the synced atelier card (F8). The atelier address, hours, email and the care, delivery and returns policy live in one synced pattern used by the footer, the Care page and the Contact page; every product shows its linen weight, kept once as a product attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the synced shelf and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H8 + F8 + L13 are as planned (combination unused: Hana Kago is H8/F4/L8, Undo Ba H8/F7/L12, Komugi Pan and Kinu Kimono use F8 with other headers/layouts, Wagu Mono is L13 with H3). The faded sage #8C8F7A is 2.9:1 on washi, so it is kept to hairlines, chapter numerals, the weave mark and large marks; links and small labels use deep sage #5A5E4C (5.7:1 on washi), secondary text quiet ink #5B564D (5.9:1 on washi, 4.6:1 on stone); pale washi #F8F6F1 panels and light sage #C3C6B2 were added. H8 differs from Hana Kago and Undo Ba by a washi veil over a light photograph with ink type (not light type on a dark photo), fading to solid washi with a hairline via a CSS scroll timeline (script fallback). F8 differs from Komugi Pan and Kinu Kimono by five square, softly desaturated photographs with spaced-capital captions (flax, weave, wash, cut, fold) over a stone colophon with the synced atelier card. L13 differs from Wagu Mono by a framed photograph of a made bed (not a drawing plate) beside four numbered chapters with small photographs and a quote. Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/crimsonpro, ofl/nunitosans): Crimson Pro instanced to weights 300-500 (roman + italic), Nunito Sans pinned to opsz 12 / wdth 100 / YTLC 500 with weights 300-700, both subset to Latin WOFF2. The Care page uses the existing generic page tag care-guide (the existing tag care is labelled Knife care); the page itself is /care/. Product photographs are 4:5 crops of the supplied photographs (the Sage Edge set, Stone trio, Fringed throw and Folded flat sheet are crops of the hero bed, pillow, weave and care photographs). Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry linen-bedding and page tag fabric-guide are new.

themes.name: Asagao Kinema
themes.description: A cinematic, bold and Japanese-modern events theme for a one-screen independent cinema in a fictional town. Shu vermilion #EB6101 covers the hero, the page heads, the intertitle cards and the ticket stub (always with sumi ink text), a sumi film strip runs under it, tokiwa green carries the membership band, and washi paper is kept for reading; Antonio, a tall condensed display, over Chivo. The pictures are sumi-e ink paintings with vermilion washes (raster WebP); in the hero a cut-out ink projector wound with morning glories breaks out of the vermilion band onto the film strip. A fixed sumi top bar (H6) holds the name, the programme dateline in ruled cells, the menu and a ticket button, with a sprocket edge. The home page is a horizontal scroll strip (L4): a giant headline with a vertical (tategaki) label on the edge, then the week as a film strip that scrolls sideways (stills alternate with vermilion and green intertitle cards), the prices on a vermilion ticket stub, a green membership band and the journal. The Programme page lays the same week out as a contact sheet. The footer rolls like end credits (F9). Pages: Programme, Visit & tickets, Membership, About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The programme, the ticket prices and the dateline are synced patterns, edited once.

themes.deviation: v1.1.0 redesign (user feedback 2026-10-15: same layout as Yoru Chocolate and Tsuba Millinery, dull colours). Codes changed from H5/F10/L12 to H6 (fixed top bar with ruled cells) + F9 (end-credits colophon) + L4 (horizontal scroll strip); the combination is unused. Archetype horizontal scroll strip, unlike Yoru (tategaki vertical scroll), Tsuba (editorial magazine) and Kumotori (scene map). Hero cut-out break-frame object: a transparent-background ink projector overlaps the edge of the vermilion band and the film strip below. Palette (user correction: no tetsukon/yamabuki or any blue, since Yoru uses those): shu vermilion dominant, sumi, washi, tokiwa green accent. IBM Plex Serif for headings, IBM Plex Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

themes.name: Eda Bonsai
themes.description: A quiet, organic store theme for a small family bonsai nursery on a hillside in Kodamadai, selling nursery-grown juniper, maple, black pine, azalea and beginner ficus with handmade pots, tools and soil, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Pale moss pages, lichen panels, deep moss ink text and a muted olive accent; Rosarivo for display, Red Hat Text for text. A slim pale-moss rail fixed to the right edge with a hairline left border holds a growth-ring mark, the Rosarivo wordmark set vertically, a fine branch line and the menu stacked below, with account and cart; on phones a plain top bar with the wordmark, Menu and cart on one line (H11). The home page opens with a short title (Trees that keep time) and four chapters (age, styling, watering, repotting) scrolling beside one sticky tree photograph that cross-fades with each chapter, with a thin olive growth-ring index; on phones the photograph sticks to the top in a short band (L13). Then featured trees with an age · height · care level line under each price, the care + delivery promise, this season from the care calendar and the journal. A newsletter-led footer: a calm lichen band for the seasonal care letter, four letters a year, then the nursery details and slim links (F4). Care calendar, Workshops and The nursery pages, journal, newsletter and contact. The nursery details, the care + delivery policy and the care calendar each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows static cells and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: Codes: none (H11 + F4 + L13 as planned; combination unused: Menya Kaen H11/F12/L7, Kasumi Bar H11/F3/L5, Kinu Kimono H11/F8/L4; Hana Kago H8/F4/L8, Oto Radio H5/F4/L12, Kumo Eyewear H6/F4/L14; Kaze Yoga H4/F7/L13, Wagu Mono H3/F9/L13, Asa Linen H8/F8/L13; neighbours #16 Engawa Works H9/F5/L6 grey and #18 Shiori Review H5/F8/L3 oat share no code or palette family). Palette as planned (pale moss #EFF0EA, lichen #C7CDB8, deep moss ink #263023, muted olive #6F6A3E) with added colours, all AA-checked: ink is 12.0:1 on pale moss, 8.4:1 on lichen and 12.9:1 on moss paper; muted olive is 4.8:1 on pale moss and 5.2:1 on paper (used there for labels, italic display and ring marks) but only 3.4:1 on lichen, so on lichen it appears only as rules and marks; deep olive #4B4A26 was added for links, small labels and buttons' hover (7.9:1 on pale moss, 5.6:1 on lichen, 8.5:1 on paper); quiet moss #485342 for secondary text (7.1:1 on pale moss, 5.0:1 on lichen); moss paper #F7F8F3 cards and a hairline #B3B9A3 (decorative). Buttons are ink with pale moss text (12.0:1); the letter band is lichen with ink text (8.4:1) and deep olive labels and links (5.6:1). H11 differs from Menya (noren), Kasumi (dark bar menu) and Kinu (plum kimono rail) as a slim 92 px pale-moss rail with a hairline left border, a growth-ring mark, the vertical Rosarivo wordmark, a fine SVG branch line and vertical-set menu items with a small olive ring on the current page; content reserves the rail width. F4 differs from Hana Kago (florist stem letter), Oto (amber podcast band) and Kumo (titanium) as a calm lichen band with a ring mark for the seasonal care letter over a moss colophon with the synced nursery card. L13 differs from Kaze (breath wave), Wagu (drawing plates) and Asa (linen) as one sticky tree photograph cross-fading per chapter (age, styling, watering, repotting) with a vertical growth-ring chapter index joined by a hairline; no JavaScript keeps the first photograph and the index links still jump; prefers-reduced-motion swaps without a fade; on phones the photograph and a horizontal ring index stick under the top bar. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Rosarivo carries the Reserved Font Names 'Rosarivo', 'Rosarivo Pro' and 'Rosarivo UGR', so its Regular and Italic TTFs ship unmodified (41 + 39 KB); Red Hat Text is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (variable Latin WOFF2 subset, weights 300-700, 30 KB). Three synced patterns: nursery details (footer, Workshops, The nursery, Contact; the footer leaves it out where the page already shows it), care + delivery policy (home short, product page short, Care calendar short, Contact in full) and the care calendar (Care calendar page in full; the home teaser shows only the current season, picked server-side from the WordPress timezone). Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry bonsai-nursery and page tag care-calendar are new (Workshops reuses the workshops tag, The nursery the about tag).

themes.name: Engawa Works
themes.description: A quiet, geometric business theme for a small neighbourhood coworking space in an old timber house with a veranda (engawa) over a courtyard. Pale concrete, soft grey and ink, with a muted ochre used only for rules and registration marks and a deeper ochre for links and buttons. A two-tier header: a slim utility strip with today's opening hours and an Open now / Opens 8:00 / Closed today chip worked out on the server from the site's timezone, the address and a Book a tour link; below it the Geologica wordmark and the menu (on phones the wordmark, the chip and a Menu button on one line). The home page is a bento grid of the space right under a short title: desks, quiet room, veranda, kitchen, events and plans as concrete cards on one hairline grid with ochre corner marks; then a word from the host, the synced membership plans with an editable Most chosen badge and the journal. The footer opens with a slow, pauseable "today at the space" ticker in Fragment Mono (static for reduced motion), then the space details and links. A thin ochre engawa rail with joints divides sections. With The space, Plans, Events, Tour booking (a request form that composes an email), Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Hours, address, phone and email are edited once in Appearance > Space details; the plans are one synced pattern. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H9 / F5 / L6 as planned). Colours as planned (concrete #F2F2EF, soft grey #D9D9D3, ink #262624, muted ochre #8A7A4E) plus: deep ochre #655835 for links, buttons' hover, codes, labels and small accents (6.2:1 on concrete, 4.9:1 on soft grey, 6.7:1 on paper), stone #5A5954 for secondary text (6.3:1 on concrete, 4.95:1 on soft grey, 6.7:1 on paper) and paper #FAFAF8 for the chosen plan, chips and form fields. Ink is 13.5:1 on concrete, 10.7:1 on soft grey and 14.5:1 on paper. Muted ochre #8A7A4E is 3.8:1 on concrete and 3.0:1 on soft grey, so it is used only for the engawa rail, registration corner marks, ticker dots, hairline underlines and the badge border, never for text.

themes.name: Fukusa Chado

Tokiwa evergreen (#007B43) is the main colour: the cover hero, the tea room band, every page head and the overlay menu are full green fields with a faint tatami weave, set in cream. The hero is centred giant type — the lesson days, the title in very large display type, the lead and the buttons on one axis — with a cut-out clay tea bowl that breaks out over the hero bottom edge and a cut-out whisk leaning out of the right edge. The four classes and a pull quote sit in a card mosaic of different sizes and colours; the tea room band sets four and a half in giant type beside rounded picture cards, with the cut-out whisk breaking over its top edge. Every picture is a soft matte 3D clay illustration. Kaisei Opti for display, Mulish for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

A formal top header: school name and tagline on the left, the menu in the bar and the Book a trial lesson button on the right; an overlay menu below 1180 px. Card mosaic: the four classes, a pull quote and a seasons picture as rounded cards of different sizes and colours on a rectangular grid, rounded picture cards and step cards throughout. Centred giant type: lesson days, eyebrow, the title in very large display type, lead and buttons on one centred axis on the green field. Full illustration: every picture is a soft matte 3D clay illustration. Break-frame: the cut-out clay tea bowl (transparent WebP) sits under the hero buttons and breaks out over the green hero bottom edge into the term board below, and the cut-out whisk leans out over the hero right edge; the cut-out whisk also breaks over the top edge of the green tea room band and over the bottom edge of every page head. themes.name: Ginrin Cycle
themes.description: A restrained, technical store theme for a small workshop that builds steel bicycles by hand and sells frames, wheels and quiet accessories, with a repair service: steel-mist pages, paper panels and graphite text with a single burnt-orange accent kept to small marks, Rubik in light weights with tight tracking and IBM Plex Mono for spec lines and prices; a header laid out like the title block of an engineering drawing, the menu as a row of hairline-ruled cells with the account and basket in the last cells, a product-first home page whose grid shares its hairlines like a drawing sheet, the build process, the repair price list and the journal, a spoke-wheel mark used as the divider and the loading indicator (still for visitors who ask for less motion), and a split two-tone footer with the graphite workshop card beside a steel panel for the newsletter and links; with custom builds and a gallery, a repair service page, about, a journal, a monthly letter and contact, the workshop address and hours, the repair prices and the product grid kept in three synced patterns so each is edited once, a dark Night Shift style variation, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

themes.name: Hanayui Kimono
themes.description: Hanayui Kimono — a WooCommerce store theme for a kimono rental and dressing shop in an old town, laid out as a hanging scroll you read from top to bottom. A formal white top header carries the shop name in the centre, the Book a fitting button, and the main menu centred on a second row with the account and the cart. Enji crimson (#B94047) is the main colour: the hero panel, the scroll spine, the collage band, every page head and the footer strip are crimson fields on plum-washi paper. The hero is a full-bleed woodblock illustration of a stone lane at dusk with a crimson panel standing on it (a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese); a cut-out kimono on its stand (transparent WebP) breaks over the panel and the hero's bottom edge. The day hangs on a crimson spine in five scenes, and a collage of pasted woodblock prints sits on a crimson band with a cut-out umbrella breaking out of it. Every picture is a woodblock-print illustration. Shippori Mincho for display, Figtree for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-29 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, full-bleed-illustration hero, centered nav, collage, woodblock, enji #B94047, Shippori Mincho + Figtree, kimono rental & dressing in fashion-beauty). A formal white top header: the shop name centred on the first row with the Book a fitting button on the right, the main menu centred on a second row between hairlines with the account and the cart; below 782 px the menu opens as a crimson overlay. Tategaki vertical scroll: the home page reads top to bottom like a hanging scroll; the day hangs on a crimson spine in five numbered scenes, and in Chinese and Japanese the hero, the scroll head and the page heads carry vertical lines (English, French and German stay horizontal). Full-bleed illustration hero: a woodblock print of an old-town lane at dusk across the whole width with a crimson panel standing on it. Collage: four woodblock prints pasted at angles with white margins on a crimson band. Break-frame: the cut-out kimono on its stand (transparent WebP) breaks over the crimson hero panel's edge and the hero's bottom edge into the shop board; the cut-out crimson umbrella breaks out of the pasted collage and over the top edge of the crimson collage band; the umbrella also breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Every picture is a woodblock-print raster illustration generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on enji #B94047 5.4:1 (hero panel, page heads, collage band, footer strip and the scroll numbers: body text and titles); paper #FBF3F0 on enji 4.9:1; deep enji #8C2A31 on paper 7.7:1 (chips on crimson, links, prices, labels) and on white 8.4:1 (white on deep 8.4:1 buttons); ink #2A1517 on paper 15.8:1, on white 17.2:1 and on mist #F4E4E0 14.0:1; plum grey #634B4D on paper 7.3:1 and on white 7.9:1 (secondary text); indigo #253458 on paper 11.2:1 (small marks; white on indigo 12.3:1); pale blush #F6D9D6 on ink 13.0:1 and white on ink 17.2:1 (footer); ink on enji only 3.2:1, never used for text.

The footer is the appointment hours table beside the atelier address on navy. With The Process (the full timeline with photographs), Cloth Book (eight swatch cards and a weight guide), Appointments, About, Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The atelier details and appointment hours are one synced pattern, edited once.

themes.name: Hibiki Records
themes.description: A quiet, dark store theme for a small independent record shop at the end of a narrow lane in Sakanoue-cho, Minase City, selling second-hand and new vinyl (jazz, ambient, folk, city pop by fictional artists) and a few care accessories, with one bookable listening booth at the back and WooCommerce templates styled to match. Charcoal pages, graphite panels, bone text and a muted grey-teal kept to fine groove rings and rules, with a paler teal for links and labels; Familjen Grotesk for display and text, Martian Mono for catalogue numbers, labels and the ticker. A slim dark bar with a hairline rule: groove mark and wordmark left, the menu, a server-side Open now chip, account and cart right; on phones wordmark, Menu and cart on one line (H1). The home page opens with one quiet line (Records, played slowly) and a record-crate mosaic of square sleeves in mixed sizes (a 2x2 feature, a 2x1 shelf crop, small sleeves), each with a Martian Mono catalogue number; the disc edge peeks out on hover (L8). Then new arrivals, the listening booth, shop details and hours and the journal. The footer opens with a slow, pauseable now-playing ticker band (still for reduced motion), then the shop card and slim links (F5). New arrivals, Listening booth (booking request form), The shop, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Shop details are edited once in Appearance > Shop details; the booth terms and the grading + shipping note are synced patterns (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows static sleeve cells and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: Codes: none (H1 + F5 + L8 as planned; combination unused: Hanabi Matsuri H1/F5/L9, Engawa Works H9/F5/L6, Hamono Kaji H6/F5/L11, Menya Kaen H7/F5; L8 in Aizome Shoten, Kami no Ne, Kami Salon, Hana Kago, Yohaku Studio, Koke Garden with other headers; neighbours #18 Shiori Review H5/F8/L3 oat light and #20 Kage Gallery H4/F3/L9 grey light share no code or palette family). Palette as planned (charcoal #17191A, graphite #262A2B, bone #E6E3DD, muted grey-teal #5C8A86) with added colours, all AA-checked: bone is 13.8:1 on charcoal and 11.3:1 on graphite; grey-teal is 4.6:1 on charcoal but 3.8:1 on graphite (fails 4.5:1), so it is used only for groove rings, rules, dots and marks, never for text; pale teal #8DB5AF was added for links, catalogue numbers and small labels (7.9:1 on charcoal, 6.5:1 on graphite, 7.1:1 on the #1E2122 cells); warm grey #A9A69F for secondary text (7.3:1 on charcoal, 6.0:1 on graphite, 6.5:1 on cells); deep graphite #1E2122 for form fields and cells and a hairline #3A3F40 (decorative, 1.7:1). Buttons are bone with charcoal text (13.8:1), pale teal with charcoal text on hover (7.9:1). H1 differs from Hanabi (festival poster bar), Shashin (film strip), Kissaten (coffee bar) and the washi split bars as a slim charcoal bar with a hairline rule, a groove-ring mark, a Martian Mono sub-line and a server-side Open now chip. F5 differs from Engawa (concrete ticker), Hamono, Menya and Hanabi (poster marquee) as a quiet graphite now-playing band in small Martian Mono at about 14 px/s (60 s minimum per loop), paused on hover/focus, with a Pause button, still under reduced motion. L8 differs from Aizome (book covers), Yohaku (crop marks), Hana Kago (pressed flowers), Koke and Kami as a record crate of square sleeves (2x2 feature, 2x1 shelf crop, 1x1 sleeves) with Martian Mono catalogue numbers and a disc edge that rises on hover. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Familjen Grotesk and Martian Mono are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name, so both ship as Latin WOFF2 subsets (Familjen Grotesk variable 400-600, 18 KB; Martian Mono width 100, weights 400-500, 15 KB). Single sources: shop details are a theme option (Appearance > Shop details) rendered by one dynamic block in the header chip, ticker, footer, Home, Listening booth, The shop and Contact; booth terms (Listening booth full, home teaser short) and the grading + shipping note (product page short, New arrivals short, Contact full) are synced patterns. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry record-shop and page tags listening-booth and new-arrivals are new (The shop reuses the about tag).

themes.name: Hidamari Care
themes.description: Hidamari Care — a theme for a small senior care residence, laid out split-screen under a formal white top-bar header: the residence name and tagline on the left, the menu in one line and an Arrange a visit button on the right. Celadon (#7EBEAB) is the main colour: the rooms-and-care section, the contact section, every page head and the time marks are celadon fields in ink type. The front page is a day schedule: a white first screen with the headline top left and one edge-to-edge celadon day line with five time marks (7:00 to 19:00), each carrying a small stacked collage of a high-key photograph over an offset celadon card, alternating above and below the line; then the day hour by hour (time, what happens, who helps, a small photo), rooms and care on a celadon field where a transparent cut-out armchair breaks out of the framed room photograph, a monthly fees table, a two-week visiting calendar, two family quotes and contact and access. Photographs are realistic high-key images (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white backgrounds, pale shadows, graded toward celadon). Zen Maru Gothic for headings, Lora for text, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: Illustration 3d-clay is rendered as high-key photographs, because the 2026-10-18 rule asks commercial themes for realistic photographs; the stacked-collage vignettes are photo cards over offset celadon cards, and the break-frame object is a transparent cut-out armchair breaking out of the framed room photo.

themes.name: Hirameki Lab
themes.description: Hirameki Lab — a theme for an after-school STEM academy (robotics, coding, science and making for ages 7 to 15), laid out as a card mosaic under a formal white top header: the lab name and tagline centred on top, a Book a trial lab button at the right and the menu as a centred row underneath (a kouji-orange numbered overlay on phones). Kouji orange (#F6AD49) is the main colour: the project tiles, the featured-project band, every page head and the overlay menu are kouji fields in graphite type. The front page leads with results: a one-line headline with a text link, then a horizontal scroll strip of five student-project cards that bleeds off the right edge, a twelve-card project wall with filter chips, one featured project read in three columns, a courses-by-age table, three lab figures and a trial band. Every project object is a transparent high-key photographic cut-out (WebP) that breaks over the top edge of its tile; a large cut-out robot arm breaks above the featured band and a bottle rocket rises out of the trial band. Photographs are realistic high-key studio images (85mm f/2.8, softbox light, near-white grounds). Space Grotesk for Latin text, Kosugi for Japanese, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: Illustration style paper-cut converted to a high-key photo direction (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white ground, pale shadows, kouji #F6AD49 accents) per the 2026-10-18 photo rule for commercial themes; the paper-cut feel stays in the layout as flat kouji tiles with cut-out objects lifted over their edges by a soft drop shadow.

themes.name: Hiyoko Kindergarten
themes.description: Hiyoko Kindergarten — a kindergarten and nursery theme laid out as a card mosaic: under a formal top header (kindergarten name, tagline and a Book a visit button), the menu leaves the bar on wide screens and becomes a fixed bark-ink side rail down the left edge with numbered entries (in Japanese the entries run top to bottom). Dandelion yellow (#FFD900) is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are yellow fields set in bark ink, with a faint paper grain. The hero is a cut-out object breaking its frame: the title, lead and buttons on the left, an ink-framed photograph of a bright classroom on the right, and a cut-out yellow backpack (transparent WebP) sitting over the frame's corner, half inside and half out, dropping past the hero bottom edge; cut-out wooden blocks break over the story band and every page head. The four classes sit in a rounded card mosaic. Every picture is a realistic 35mm film-grain photograph of a modern, international kindergarten. M PLUS Rounded 1c for display, Fredoka for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: Illustration only: the plan row says woodblock, and the 2026-10-18 image rule turns every new commercial theme to realistic photographs, so woodblock became the film-grain photo direction (35mm, 50mm f/2, natural side light, visible grain, slightly faded, graded toward dandelion #FFD900), the closest in its flat, grainy, printed feel. Everything else is built exactly to design-plan.json row b5-2 (card-mosaic, cutout-break-frame-object hero, side-rail nav, cutout-break-frame, dandelion #FFD900, M PLUS Rounded 1c + Fredoka, education-classes). Break-frame: the cut-out backpack breaks out of the framed hero photo and the hero bottom edge; cut-out wooden blocks break over the story band and page heads.

themes.name: Hōchō Kyōshitsu
themes.description: Hōchō Kyōshitsu — A washoku cooking school theme built as a card mosaic in gunjō ultramarine (#4C6CB3), the main colour on the hero card, every page head, the header bar and the footer, over washi-textured pale paper with sumi indigo ink; Yuji Syuku brush display over Albert Sans. The art is pencil-sketch raster illustration (graphite hatching with ultramarine pencil accents): a yanagiba knife on a hinoki board and a whole sea bream as transparent cut-outs that break out of their cards, plus a dashi pot, a katsuramuki lesson, a bento and the school kitchen. A full top header: one ultramarine bar with the school name, the menu and a Book a class button. The home page is a mosaic of cards: the large ultramarine title card with a vertical Japanese spine and the cut-out knife crossing its edge, class cards, the sea bream swimming over the four-week course card, the synced fees card and the journal. The fees card and the school details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

Contrast: white on gunjō #4C6CB3 5.1:1 (body text on the ultramarine fields), persimmon #FFC98B on gunjō 3.4:1 (large display text only), sumi ink #151C33 on paper #F3F5FA 15.5:1, deep ultramarine #2D4A8E on paper 7.8:1, white on deep #2D4A8E 8.5:1, slate #46506B on white 8.0:1, ink on mist #DCE3F2 13.1:1.

themes.name: Hogusu Physio
themes.description: A clean, serene and modern health theme for a small neighbourhood physiotherapy clinic in a fictional town. Sea-glass mist pages, a pale sea-glass wash for panels, deep sea ink for text and one muted deep teal for lines, dots and numerals; Wix Madefor Display for headings over Wix Madefor Text. The hero and the chapter pictures are continuous single-line drawings (raster WebP; one unbroken deep-teal stroke per figure). Every page opens with a two-tier header (H9): a utility strip with today's hours and the phone number over the main bar with the menu and a "Book an assessment" pill. The home page is a single-column long read (L7) that walks through one first appointment in four chapters - assessment, hands-on, exercises, follow-up - each one row with its number on a dotted rail and a line drawing, then fees, the team and the journal. The footer is a quiet "Book an assessment" band over the clinic details and a small sitemap (F7). Pages: Treatments, Your first visit, Fees, Team, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Hours, phone and address are edited once in Appearance > Clinic details; the locator card and the fees table are synced patterns.

Neighbours: Nijimi Tenugui (H10/F8/L13, blue light) and Yoru Chocolate share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (sea-glass mist #EFF3F2, wash #D8E3E1, deep sea ink #1F3330, muted deep teal #4F7C76) plus deep teal #355C56 for small links (6.7:1 on mist / 5.7:1 on wash), slate teal #4A5E5B for quiet text (6.2:1 / 5.3:1) and paper cards #F8FAF9; muted teal #4F7C76 (4.2:1) is for lines, dots, numerals and large type only. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Wix Madefor Display and Wix Madefor Text are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name; shipped as the unmodified upstream variable TTFs (wght 400-800) because no subsetting toolchain was available this round. Industry physiotherapy is new. Built from the Mimi Veterinary structure (same H9 utility strip + F7 band), with a new L7 single-column home. 4 raster single-line illustrations (WebP, Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh), checked by eye for text and logos; team members are text cards without portraits (image budget).

themes.name: Hokuto Driving School
themes.description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a family driving school: pale concrete, kerb stone and asphalt ink with one deep slate-green band and a faded road-sign sage, Newsreader over Instrument Sans. The home page opens on a full-bleed photograph of an empty early-morning road under a transparent top header, with a quiet facts bar along its foot; then a letter from the owner beside the practice yard, the route from the yard to test day as six photographed stages, plain prices beside a lesson photograph, the four instructors, a dark band for nervous drivers with a learner's words, the journal and a booking call. With Courses & fees, The Route (six stages in detail), Instructors, Nervous drivers, Test day, About (the school year by year and a day at the depot), Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The school details and booking-desk hours are one synced pattern, edited once.

themes.name: Hoshizora Camp
themes.description: Hoshizora Camp — a glamping-site theme laid out like an app: under a full top header, a deep-navy sidebar holds the synced camp board (tonight's sky, free tents, the fire circle, quiet hours and a Book a site button) beside the scrolling page. Hatobanezumi, the dove mauve-grey of traditional Japanese dyeing (#9E8B8E), is the main colour: the header, the hero, every page head and the silver-grass band are dove-grey fields with nōkon deep-navy type, on an unbleached kinari ground with pale shirafuji wisteria panels, keshimurasaki muted-purple links and small touches of kōiro incense gold and geppaku moon white on navy. The header splits the menu around the centred camp name, with the Book a site button at its end. The hero is a scene map: a watercolour map of the camp in a white frame with numbered pins for the lodge, tents, domes, star deck, fire circle and creek, and a cut-out bell tent that steps out of the frame and over the hero edge; a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band. Every picture is a watercolour illustration. Klee One for display, Gothic A1 for reading. The sample content comes in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: v1.0.2 recolour (2026-10-16): the main colour is now hatobanezumi dove mauve-grey #9E8B8E with a nōkon deep-navy night, for a quieter, more refined look; the sample meadow is now silver grass, and the pictures were regenerated in the new palette. Otherwise built to design-plan.json row b3-21 (sidebar-app, scene-map hero, split nav, full-illustration images, watercolour, Klee One + Gothic A1). Every picture is a watercolour raster illustration generated with Grok Build; break-frame: a cut-out bell tent steps out of the framed site map and over the hero edge, and a cut-out camp lantern hangs over the night band's top edge. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de (demo-content.<lang>.json + inc/i18n/<lang>.php + inc/info/<lang>/). Contrast: nōkon navy #0F2350 on hatobanezumi #9E8B8E 4.75:1 (all text on the dove-grey header, hero, page heads and silver-grass band); navy on kinari paper #FBFAF5 14.6:1; keshimurasaki #594255 on paper 8.6:1 (links, labels); paper on keshimurasaki 8.6:1; keshimurasaki on shirafuji #DBD0E6 6.1:1; aisabi #455765 on paper 7.2:1 (secondary text); aisabi on shirafuji 5.1:1; navy on shirafuji 10.3:1; kōiro gold #EFCD9A on navy 10.1:1 (labels, times, prices on the sidebar and night band); geppaku #EAF4FC on navy 13.7:1; paper on navy 14.6:1; hatobanezumi on navy 4.75:1 (sidebar button, footer rule); navy on the white map frame 15.3:1; white on hatobanezumi only 3.2:1, never used for text.

themes.description: Hotaru Ehon — a picture-book illustrator theme set like a poster: under a formal top header (studio name, menu and the Commission a book button in one bar, a full-screen imayo overlay on phones and tablets) the home page opens with the title in giant type across the whole width, and a picture-book map of the riverside village overlapping it with three glowing firefly pins, the places where books began. Imayo (#D0576B), the old Japanese "fashionable" pink, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are imayo fields set in dark ink. The hero breaks the frame: a cut-out firefly jar (transparent WebP) breaks out of the map frame over its top edge and into the giant title; a cut-out fox with a picture book breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a flat 2D illustration in imayo pink, indigo night, cream and firefly yellow. Cherry Bomb One for display (with a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset in Japanese), Quicksand for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-16 (poster-typographic, scene-map hero, top-bar nav, cutout-break-frame, 2d-flat, imayo #D0576B, Cherry Bomb One + Quicksand, arts-media). A formal top header with the studio name, the menu and the Commission a book button in one bar. Cherry Bomb One has kana but few kanji, so Japanese headings add a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset. White on imayo is only 3.99:1, so all small text on the imayo fields is dark ink. Vertical type only in Chinese and Japanese; Latin text stays horizontal. Break-frame: the cut-out firefly jar breaks out of the map frame and into the giant title, the cut-out fox over the story band and every page head.

themes.description: Ichiba Monozukuri — a monthly craft market theme laid out like a printed market magazine: a masthead top bar with the market name, a horizontal menu and a Visit button. Ai indigo (#165E83) is the main colour: the hero, every page head and the season band are indigo fields with white type. The hero is a stacked collage of two risograph prints (stalls under awnings, hands carving a spoon) with a cut-out still life of a teapot, basket and indigo cloth breaking out of the collage and over the hero edge; a cut-out bowl breaks over the market-day band. Every picture is a two-ink risograph illustration (indigo and vermilion, halftone grain, slight misregistration). Train One for display, Hanken Grotesk for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

A full masthead top bar (market name, horizontal menu, Apply for a stall button; overlay menu on small screens). Sections open like magazine pages with numbered heads on a thick rule and two-column text. Every picture is a two-ink risograph illustration generated with Grok Build (indigo and vermilion, halftone grain); break-frame: a transparent cut-out still life (teapot, basket, indigo cloth) breaks out of the stacked hero collage and over the hero edge, and a cut-out bowl breaks over the market-day band. themes.name: Itomaki Yarn
themes.description: Itomaki Yarn — a WooCommerce store theme for a small yarn shop in an old merchant house, set like a poster. A formal white top header carries the shop name on the left, the main menu centred and the Shop the yarn button, account and cart on the right (a full-screen red menu on phones). Kankurenai red (#E95464) is the main colour: the hero field, every page head, the shop-board card, the farm card and the footer strip are red fields with plum-black ink type on rose-white paper. The hero is a diagonal split: a red field cut on a diagonal over a watercolour of the shop, the shop line set as a giant poster headline (a vertical line beside it in Chinese and Japanese), and a cut-out spool of red yarn (transparent WebP) sitting on the seam and breaking over the hero's bottom edge. Five steps from fleece to spool stand as giant red numerals; a full-bleed watercolour of the hill farm carries a red card that a cut-out skein breaks out of. Soft watercolour illustrations throughout. Hachi Maru Pop for display, Nunito for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-6 (poster-typographic, diagonal-split hero, centered nav, cutout-break-frame, watercolour, kankurenai #E95464, Hachi Maru Pop + Nunito, yarn shop in shops-hobbies). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left, the main menu centred in the bar, the Shop the yarn button, account and cart on the right (a full-screen red menu below 1024 px). Poster-typographic: giant Hachi Maru Pop headlines (hero, steps, page heads) and giant red step numerals; a huge pale thread character behind the hero type. Diagonal-split hero: a kankurenai red field cut on a diagonal over a watercolour of the shop. Watercolour: every picture is a soft watercolour raster illustration. Break-frame: the cut-out spool of red yarn (transparent WebP) sits on the diagonal seam between the red field and the shop watercolour and breaks over the hero's bottom edge into the shop board; a cut-out skein breaks out of the red card over the top edge of the full-bleed hill-farm band; the spool also breaks over the diagonal bottom edge of every page head. Images generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de; vertical lines only in zh and ja. Contrast: plum-black ink #200C10 on kankurenai #E95464 5.3:1 (all text on the red hero field, page heads, the board card, the farm card, the header button and the footer strip); white on kankurenai 3.5:1 only for the giant hero headline (large text, 3:1 rule); ink on rose-white paper #FFF8F7 17.9:1, on white 18.7:1 and on blush #FCE6E8 15.7:1; deep madder #A8243A on paper 6.7:1, on white 7.1:1 and on blush 5.9:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.1:1); mauve grey #6A474D on paper 7.6:1 and on white 8.0:1 (secondary text); white on ink 18.7:1 and pale rose #F7C3C9 on ink 12.1:1 (buttons, chips, footer); kankurenai on paper 3.4:1 only for the giant step numerals (large text); deep madder on kankurenai 2.0:1, never used for text.

themes.name: Jika Tabi
themes.description: Jika Tabi — a store theme for a split-toe tabi and jika-tabi work-boot maker, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Tetsukon iron navy (#17184B) is the main colour: the header, the hero, the sticky making story, every page head, the bands and the footer are navy fields with washi-white type, kohaze-brass labels and vermilion numbers; New Tegomin for display and Lexend for reading. A centred giant-type hero sits over a full layered paper-cut illustration, with a vertical Japanese label at the edge and a cut-out boot that steps out over the hero into the next section; the menu always opens as a full-screen overlay. Below, a sticky-media story pins the paper-cut picture while the five making steps scroll past, then the tabi, the journal and the shop letter. All illustrations are generated in one layered paper-cut (kirie) style. The shop details and the cloth-and-care notes each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the tabi show as static cells and orders go by email).

Every picture is a layered paper-cut raster illustration generated with Grok Build; the boot is also a transparent cut-out that steps out of the hero (break-frame). Contrast: washi white #EFEDE6 on tetsukon #17184B 14.1:1 (all text on the navy header, hero, sticky story, page heads, bands and footer); pale indigo #B4B8D6 on tetsukon 8.5:1; kohaze brass #D9B866 on tetsukon 8.7:1 (labels, buttons, vertical labels; tetsukon on brass buttons 8.7:1); vermilion #EC8266 on tetsukon 6.3:1 (numbers and emphasis); tetsukon on paper #F2F1EE 14.7:1; deep red links #9C2A1C on paper 6.7:1; quiet #4F5170 on paper 6.8:1; red #B83A2A on paper 5.1:1.

themes.name: Kage Gallery
themes.description: A quiet, typographic portfolio theme for a small contemporary art gallery showing painting, works on paper and small sculpture in a white room by the river. Wall white and stone grey, charcoal text, a muted bronze kept to frames, hairlines and large marks, and a deeper bronze for links and small labels; Gelasio for the oversized titles and text, Inter Tight for dates, wall labels and the menu. A white-cube bar with only the wordmark and a Menu button opens a full-screen pale-wall menu with large Gelasio items and the visit details beside them (H4). The home page sets the current exhibition title very large over white space, then a ruled line of dates and artist and the wall text, a calm row of four works with wall labels, the next exhibitions, the visit details and the journal (L9). Works carry a fine shadow edge, as if hung. The footer is one hairline row of visit details and slim links (F3). With Exhibitions (now on view, upcoming, past), Artists, Visit, About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The visit details, the current exhibition and the upcoming exhibitions are each one synced pattern, edited once.

themes.description: Kakei Advisors — a theme for an independent, fee-only financial planner, laid out in horizontal strips under a formal white top header (office name, tagline, a Book a first meeting button and a menu button); the menu opens as a full-screen pine-green overlay with large numbered entries at every width. Matsuba pine green (#42602D) is the main colour: the hero, the office band, every page head and the overlay are green fields in white type with a soft wash. The hero is a framed window: the title, lead, buttons and the questions of the month on the left, the meeting room seen through a white window frame with glazing bars on the right, and a cut-out olive tree (transparent WebP) standing over the frame's lower corner and breaking past the hero bottom edge; a cut-out green notebook breaks over the office band and every page head. The services run as ruled horizontal strips (number, photo, title, facts, line) and the life stages as one long sideways-scrolling strip. Every picture is a realistic 35mm film-grain photograph of a modern, international setting. Noto Serif JP for display, Inter for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: Illustration only: the plan row says watercolour, and the 2026-10-18 image rule turns every new commercial theme to realistic photographs, so watercolour became the film-grain photo direction (35mm, 50mm f/2, natural side light, visible grain, slightly faded like a wash, graded toward matsuba green). full-illustration = every hero and content picture is a full photograph; a soft CSS wash sits on the green fields.

themes.name: Kamisori Barber
themes.description: Kamisori Barber — a barbershop theme read as one long column: under a formal top header (shop name, menu and the Book a chair button in one bar, a full-screen kyo-murasaki overlay on phones and tablets) every section keeps its text in a single centred reading column, and the pictures hang out into the margins as torn, taped paper-cut pieces. Kyo-murasaki (#9D5B8B), the old Kyoto purple, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are murasaki fields set in white. The hero breaks the frame: a paper-cut picture of the shop in a white window frame, with a cut-out barber chair (transparent WebP) breaking out of the frame and over the hero bottom edge; a cut-out shaving mug and brush breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a layered paper-cut illustration in murasaki, lilac, sumi and muted gold. Chokokutai for display (with a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset in Japanese), Epilogue for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-14 (single-column-longform, cutout-break-frame-object hero, top-bar nav, collage, paper-cut, kyo-murasaki #9D5B8B, Chokokutai + Epilogue, fashion-beauty). A formal top header with the shop name, the menu and the Book a chair button in one bar. Chokokutai has kana but few kanji, so Japanese headings add a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset. Vertical type only in Chinese and Japanese; Latin text stays horizontal. Break-frame: the cut-out barber chair breaks out of the window frame and over the hero bottom edge, the cut-out shaving brush over the story band and every page head.

themes.name: Kanmi Dokoro
themes.description: Kanmi Dokoro — a wagashi tea house theme with a formal top bar (tea house name, a one-row menu and a Reserve a window seat button). Kikyo bellflower purple (#5654A2) is the main colour: the hero half, every page head, the menu panel and the calendar band are kikyo fields with a bellflower watercolour multiplied in, set in white. The site is built as split screens: the hero sets the kikyo field beside a paper wall where the garden is framed as an open window, and a cut-out bellflower sweet breaks out of the window frame across the seam; a cut-out matcha bowl breaks over the calendar band and the sweet sits across the seam of every page head. Every picture is a soft watercolour illustration. Hina Mincho for display, Outfit for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

themes.name: Kanna Komuten
themes.description: Kanna Komuten — a machiya renovation carpenter theme built on split screens, with a formal top header: the workshop name and tagline on the left, the Request a survey button on the right, and on wide screens the menu as a fixed sumi-ink side rail of numbered entries down the left edge (an overlay menu on phones and tablets). Ukon turmeric yellow (#FABF14) is the main colour: the hero half, the workshop band, every page head and the overlay menu are solid turmeric fields set in sumi ink. The hero is a full-bleed 35mm film photograph of a machiya under renovation running edge to edge, with the left half covered by the turmeric text panel; a cut-out hand plane sits on the seam and breaks out over the photograph and the hero bottom edge. Split-screen layout throughout: recent work as a text half beside a tall photograph, the workshop band as a turmeric half with the founding year in giant type beside a half of three photographs, projects as split rows, and every page head as a turmeric half beside a full-height photograph. Every picture is a photorealistic film-grain photograph (50mm, natural side light, fine grain, faded colour graded toward turmeric). Zen Kaku Gothic Antique for display, Schibsted Grotesk for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-4 (split-screen, full-bleed hero, side-rail nav, real-photography, film-grain, ukon #FABF14, Zen Kaku Gothic Antique + Schibsted Grotesk, business-services). The hero is full-bleed as planned; because the image column is real-photography, the full-bleed picture is a film photograph rather than an illustration. A formal top header: workshop name and tagline on the left, the Request a survey button on the right; from 1100 px the menu is a fixed sumi-ink side rail of numbered entries down the left edge (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese), an overlay menu on phones and tablets. Split screen: the hero, recent work, the workshop band, projects and every page head are two halves, a turmeric or text half and a photograph half. Break-frame: the cut-out hand plane (transparent WebP) sits on the seam between the turmeric hero half and the full-bleed photograph and breaks out over both and over the hero bottom edge into the workshop board; the same cut-out breaks over the top edge of the turmeric workshop band on its split seam and over the seam and bottom edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Sans TC Bold subset (gothic, matching Zen Kaku Gothic Antique).

themes.name: Kaori Cosme
themes.description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small clean-skincare atelier in Tokyo, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Lilac-grey pages, paper-white panels and ink-violet text and bands, with muted lilac kept to fine lines and small accents; Literata for headings and Mulish for text. A floating frosted pill header, a home page that opens on a full-bleed photograph, quiet glass-drop reflections on product cards, cells and dividers (soft CSS highlights, still for those who ask for less motion), the shelf of featured products, four ingredients (yuzu, rice, camellia, green tea), the morning and evening routines, the journal, and a one-line footer. Pages for home, shop, ingredients, routines, about, the journal, a seasonal newsletter and contact, plus shop, product, cart, checkout, account, order confirmation and product search templates (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the shelf and orders go by phone or email). The atelier address and hours, and the shelf with its prices and badge, live in two synced patterns, so each is edited once.
themes.deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and header, footer and layout codes are as planned (#F3EEF7 #B7A6D9 #2D2A3E, Literata + Mulish, clean + luxe, H10 + F3 + L1; the combination is unused). Kept quiet at the user's request: muted lilac #B7A6D9 is only used for fine lines, the glass-drop marks and small accents (1.9:1, never for text); lilac accent text uses the deeper #65568F (5.6:1 on the ground), quiet text #5E5873 (5.9:1). A paper white #FCFBFD and a lilac haze #E7E0EF were added for panels.

themes.name: Karan Geta
themes.description: Karan Geta — a WooCommerce store theme for a geta (wooden sandal) workshop on a hot-spring street, laid out as a hanging scroll you read from top to bottom. A formal white top header carries the shop name, the Book a fitting button, account and cart; the main menu always opens from a Menu button as a full-screen shinbashi turquoise overlay (set vertically in Chinese and Japanese). Shinbashi turquoise (#59B9C6) is the main colour: the hero field, the menu overlay, the scroll spine, every page head and the footer strip are turquoise fields with sumi blue-black text on pale turquoise washi. The hero is a vertical banner: a tall woodblock print of the hot-spring street hangs like a shop banner from a wooden rod, beside the shop line (a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese); a cut-out pair of geta (transparent WebP) steps off the banner and over the hero's bottom edge. Five workshop steps hang on a turquoise spine, and a full-bleed woodblock band of the paulownia yard carries a turquoise card that a second pair of geta breaks out of. Every picture is a full woodblock-print illustration. Yuji Boku for display, Jost for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
themes.deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-5 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, vertical-banner hero, overlay nav, full-illustration, woodblock, shinbashi #59B9C6, Yuji Boku + Jost, geta sandals in fashion-beauty). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left; the Book a fitting button, account, cart and a Menu button on the right; the main menu always opens as a full-screen turquoise overlay (set vertically in Chinese and Japanese). Tategaki vertical scroll: the home page reads top to bottom like a hanging scroll; five workshop steps hang on a turquoise spine, and in Chinese and Japanese the hero, the scroll head, the page heads and the menu overlay carry vertical lines (English, French and German stay horizontal). Vertical-banner hero: a tall woodblock print of the hot-spring street hangs like a shop banner from a wooden rod on a full turquoise field. Full illustration: every picture is a full woodblock-print raster illustration (no photos); the paulownia band is one illustration edge to edge. Break-frame: the cut-out pair of geta (transparent WebP) steps off the foot of the hanging street banner and over the turquoise hero's bottom edge into the workshop board; a second cut-out pair breaks out of the turquoise card and over the top edge of the full-bleed paulownia band; the geta also break over the bottom edge of every page head. Images generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: sumi blue-black #10272B on shinbashi turquoise #59B9C6 6.8:1 (all text on the hero field, the menu overlay, page heads, the board lead card, the scroll numbers, the band card and the footer strip); ink on pale turquoise washi #F1F8F9 14.5:1, on white 15.6:1 and on steam mist #DCEFF2 13.1:1; deep teal #1D5F6A on paper 6.7:1, on white 7.2:1 and on mist 6.1:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.2:1); slate teal #3E585C on paper 7.1:1 and on white 7.6:1 (secondary text); white on ink 15.6:1 (buttons, chips, footer) and pale turquoise #BEE5EB on ink 11.6:1; cypress wood #7A5233 on paper 6.3:1 (small marks); white on turquoise only 2.3:1 and deep teal on turquoise 3.2:1, never used for text.

themes.name: Kasumi Bar
themes.description: A quiet, night-dark theme for a small reservation-first cocktail bar: a green-black ground, deep bottle-green panels, parchment type and fine antique-gold hairlines; Noto Serif Display over Josefin Sans. The bar's name and every chapter title are set in vertical type, and the menu runs down the right edge in vertical type (a compact menu button on phones). The home page is one sparse column: the name beside a candle-lit counter, tonight's seasonal drinks, the bar, the visit details and the journal. The menu card has fine gold dotted leaders, and the footer is a single hairline-gold line with the name, address, hours and a reservations link. With a menu, reservations, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The seasonal drinks, the menu card and the visit details (address, hours, reservation policy) are synced patterns, edited once.

themes.description: Katsuji Press — A letterpress print shop theme laid out as horizontal strips in asagi light blue-green (#00A3AF), the main colour on the header bar, the hero, the process band and every page head, with sumi ink black, cool cotton paper and deep asagi links; Potta One display over Noto Sans JP. A full top header: a sumi strip with an Order a quote button, then the menu split into two halves either side of the centred press name. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. The print menu and the press details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

themes.name: Kaze Yoga
themes.description: A calm, airy theme for small yoga studios: a pale mist ground with sage and pine-ink, Gowun Batang headings and Lexend text, and a slow breath line (a soft drifting wave) as the signature; a header that is only the wordmark and a Menu button opening a full-screen numbered menu; a home page told in four chapters where each photograph stays while its words scroll past; a footer that is one big band inviting visitors to book a free trial class above the studio details; with about, a weekly timetable, the teachers, a trial class with a booking form, a journal, a newsletter and contact. themes.name: Kenban Piano School
themes.description: A quiet, typographic education theme for a small piano school in a wooden house. Paper white, ivory and ebony, with one muted brass accent used only for large type and small marks (the raised key's baseline, today's timetable bar, the free-first-lesson dot and the five staff lines before each label). The header is a row of ruled cells read like a keyboard: the wordmark in the first cell, each menu item a white key with short ebony black keys between them, the current page a raised paper-white key. The home page is oversized type only: one tempo marking, Andante, set very large on five faint staff lines with a short gloss and the term at a glance beneath, then the five lessons and fees as ruled rows, five tempo words from Largo to Allegro that tell how a pupil moves through the school, the next recital date in tall numerals, the journal as text rows and the free first lesson. The footer is the weekly lesson timetable on ebony, with today marked from the site's timezone, beside the school details. With Lessons, Teachers, Recitals, The school, Journal, Newsletter and Contact (a first-lesson enquiry that composes an email, no backend). The school details, the term, the lesson fees and the timetable are synced patterns, edited once. Linden Hill over Atkinson Hyperlegible. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

themes.name: Kinari Soba
themes.description: A quiet, serene food-and-drink theme for a small hand-cut soba house. Buckwheat grey, pale grey-green and ink, with one muted husk-green accent used only for large type and small marks. The name and the menu run in vertical type down a pale grey-green rail on the right edge (a compact bar with a menu button on phones). The home page is a bento of square tiles in hairline seiro-tray frames: a soft watercolour of a tray of soba, the name and a short line, today's note (what is sold out for today), the hours with today's row marked from the site's timezone, a watercolour buckwheat sprig and the stone mill; then the menu as four square trays (cold, warm, the season, sake and small plates) with tabular prices, a wide watercolour of the buckwheat field with the morning's three steps, and the journal as square cards. The footer is a watercolour street map beside the address card with the noren line. With Menu, The mill, Journal, Newsletter and Visit. The hours, today's note and the menu are synced patterns, edited once. Hero and decoration are vector watercolours; the dish photographs are raster. Kaisei HarunoUmi over Murecho. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

themes.name: Kinu Kimono
themes.description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small kimono rental and dressing house in Kyoto, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Silk-mist pages, washi-ivory panels and ink text, deep plum for the menu rail, the dressing panels and the footer, and antique gold kept to hairlines, hooks and small marks; Zen Old Mincho for headings and Zen Kaku Gothic New for text. A vertical menu rail on the right edge in Japanese-style vertical type, a home page built around a sideways-scrolling kimono rack of rental plans that hang from a gold rail (scroll-snap, keyboard and touch scrollable, still for those who ask for less motion), the steps of a rental day, the dressing service, the journal, and a photo-strip footer over the plum colophon. Pages for home, plans, how it works (steps and dressing), the shop, about, the journal, a seasonal letter and contact, plus shop, product, cart, checkout, account, order confirmation and product search templates (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the plan rack and bookings go by phone or email). The house address and hours, the rack of plans with its prices and badge, and the footer photo strip live in three synced patterns, so each is edited once.
themes.deviation: Planned as an ornate, festive look with #3B1F4E, #E8B04A and #F4E9F2. Changed at the user's request (elegant, restrained, refined Japanese; no bright colours, no poster look): the bright gold is muted to antique gold #B8924A and kept to hairlines, the rack rail, hooks and small marks (#7E6230 for gold text on light grounds, AA), the ground is silk mist #F4EEF2 with washi ivory #FBF8F3 panels and ink #221A28 text; style tags are elegant + traditional instead of ornate + festive. Fonts (Zen Old Mincho + Zen Kaku Gothic New) and header, footer and layout codes are as planned (H11, F8, L4; the combination is unused).

themes.name: Kiroku Studio
themes.description: A bold, kinetic theme for creative agencies, motion studios and brand designers: a near-black ground, white type and one neon green, Bricolage Grotesque headlines that stretch along their width axis over Figtree text. The wordmark sits top-left and the menu is a numbered index (01 Work, 02 Services…) in the corner of every title card. The home page scrolls sideways: a case-study reel that snaps card by card (swipe it, scroll it, or Tab in and use the arrow keys) with a progress line, then two marquee lines of type, service rows that fill green on hover, the studio and the journal in a sideways row. The footer ends in a giant wordmark that turns neon green, with a green bar sweeping in, when pointed at. With a work index whose rows slide their photograph in, four case studies, services with prices and a sideways process track, about with the team, a journal, a newsletter and contact; the studio's address, email, phone and social links are edited in one place. All motion is CSS and stops for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

themes.description: Kizuki Construction — a theme for a general construction contractor, set as one clean reading column under a formal white split header: the company name in the centre, the menu split two left and two right, and a Request a site survey button at the far right. Konjo navy (#113285) is the main colour: the metrics ledger, the survey call, every page head and the buttons are navy fields in white type. The front page is a metrics ledger: a white first screen on a 12-column grid with a giant handover count (1,284) in bengara Roboto Condensed on the left, the headline, one paragraph and one button on the right and a thin documentary photo strip of a concrete pour along the bottom; then a ledger of six published figures on a navy field, a ten-year safety trend chart, a register of eight recent projects with photo thumbnails, one wide site photograph, report downloads and a navy survey call where a transparent cut-out safety helmet breaks out over the band edge. Photographs are realistic documentary images (35mm wide, available light, handheld, fine grain, graded toward navy). Zen Kaku Gothic Antique for headings, Roboto Condensed for text and figures, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
